LearnerProfile.title: LearnerProfile
LearnerProfile.description: Stores a learner's preferences, settings, and complete French learning and gamification progress.

uid.description: The immutable Firebase Authentication UID of the learner.

email.description: Learner's email address from Google Sign-In.

settingsJson.description: Serialized JSON of UserSettings (learnerName, uiLanguage, level, dailyGoalMinutes, darkMode, audioEnabled).

progressJson.description: Serialized JSON of UserProgress (xp, streakDays, completedLessonIds, dailyHistory, xpHistory, achievements).

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user document storing Phrase juste settings and learning progress.
